# The check accepts a workflow that reads the round settings from facts().vars, and refuses a round field that facts() does not have.
isolate

exec beehavereal check workflow ok.star
! stdout .
! stderr .

! exec beehavereal check workflow bad.star
stderr 'round_base is not a field of the result of facts'

-- ok.star --
def main(item):
    f = facts()
    command(run = ["echo", f.vars["round"]["base"]], name = "show")
-- bad.star --
def main(item):
    f = facts()
    command(run = ["echo", f.round_base], name = "show")
